title: Crisis detector, English
notes: TIER IS NOW gate. The floors are unmoved (PR #137's frozen-grader rule): recall_must_detect still 0.98, fp_rate_hard_negatives still 0.02, fp_rate_neutral still 0.0 — the tier flipped because the detector met them, not because they were relaxed. B1b closed the 14 residual misses B1 left behind, all in families the means work never touched: passive_ideation 6 ('i wish i wasnt here anymore', 'nothing would change if i was gone', 'i wish i had never been born'), explicit_intent 3 ('i wrote a note already', 'im going to end it tonight after everyone is asleep', 'i want to be gone'), means_pills 3 (preparation rather than the act: saving, counting, 'everything in the cabinet'), selfharm_cutting 1 (burning) and abuse 1 ('i keep getting hurt at home'). details.recallByFamily now reports every family at 1.0 over 295 must-detect rows, and headline recall moved 0.7087 (suite creation) -> 0.794 -> 0.9498 (B1) -> 1.0. fp_rate_hard_negatives fell 0.0055 -> 0.005 over a corpus grown by 34 new guard rows in five new benign families (absence_locative, wake_up_benign, no_point_benign, gone_benign, note_benign, burn_accident); the only firings left are the two knife_kitchen rows recorded since the suite was created ('i cut myself chopping onions last night', 'i cut myself shaving this morning'), which the pre-existing hurt/harm/cut entry owns. Recall 1.0 is a corpus result, not a claim about the world: crisis-detection.ts names what still leaks in-file (a benign note with no addressee, 'i been burning myself again' without 'on purpose', gap-width truncation on the pills entry), and those shapes are absent from this corpus by construction. If recall ever drops below 0.99 the tolerance opens a watch; below 0.98 it fails the PR. Correct the detector, never the floor.
